name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, January 16, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-m, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special and Regular Meetings of December 19, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
November Treasurer Report
ACTION: That the November report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Consideration of a Resolution of Public Convenience and Necessity relative to Conditional Use Permit No. 307 for the sale of beer, wine, and distilled spirits for property located at 2130 Pacific Coast Highway in the C-R (Commercial Retail) Zone
Res 2018-01 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, resolving the public convenience and necessity for an ABC License for the sale of beer, wine, and distilled spirits for off-site consumption at 2130 Pacific Coast Highway.
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the resolution.
Item #7j
k.
Consideration of a resolution denying a claim against the City filed by Emerald Church of Open Faith and Alanna Reeves
Res. 2018-02 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, denying the claim submitted by the Emerald Church of Open Faith and Alanna Reeves.
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the resolution denying a claim against the City filed by the Emerald Church of Open Faith and Alanna Reeves and authorize the City Attorney to send a denial letter to the claimant.
Item #7k
l.
Consideration of a managed Information Technology Service Contract - Second Amendment
ACTION: That the City Council approve a second amendment to the current agreement with Acorn Technology Corporation (Acorn) for Management Information Technology Services (MITs) and enter into a month to month agreement for $4,455 per month ($53,460 annually) and authorize the City Manager to sign the amendment. The agreement shall continue on a month to month basis until at the latest December 31, 2018, unless earlier termination occurs under Section 11 of this Agreement or the Agreement is extended in writing in advance by both parties.
Item #7l
m.
Consideration of a resolution requesting that Caltrans remove on-street parking on Pacific Coast Highway
Res 2018-03 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California requesting that Caltrans remove on-street parking from Pacific Coast Highway within the City limits.
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the resolution requesting that Caltrans remove all on-street parking along Pacific Coast Highway within the City of Lomita.
Item #7m
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
RECEIVE AND FILE A CLIMATE ACTION PLAN PREPARED BY SOUTH BAY CITIES COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENT
Presented by South Bay Cities Council of Governments (SBCCOG) Staff
Res 2018-04 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, adopting the Climate Action Plan (CAP) with the existing approved Energy Efficiency (EE) Chapter and the additional Land Use/Transportation (LUT), Solid Waste, Urban Greening, and Energy Generation/Storage Chapters as a policy guidance document for assessing, prioritizing, and implementing future projects within the City.
ACTION: That the City Council adopt a resolution adopting the Climate Action Plan (CAP) with the existing approved EE Chapter and the additional LUT, Waste, Greening, and Energy Generation/Storage chapters.
Item #8
9.
CONSIDERATION OF AN AWARD OF CONTRACT TO GRUBER AND ASSOCIATES FOR CITYWIDE AUDIT SERVICES
Presented by Administrative Services Director Kamada
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into a three (3) year agreement with the option to renew for two (2) additional one-year periods, with Gruber and Associates for citywide audit services.
Item #9
10.
ESTABLISH A DATE AND TIME FOR THE ANNUAL GOAL SETTING WORKSHOP AND MID-YEAR BUDGET REVIEW
Presented by Administrative Services Director Kamada
ACTION: Staff recommends that Tuesday, February 27, 2018 be selected with the meeting starting at 4:30 p.m.
Item #10
11.
SELECT A MEETING DATE AND TIME FOR A JOINT MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD
Presented by Parks & Recreation Director Harding
ACTION: That the City Council select one of the following dates and time for a joint meeting with the Railroad Museum Board:
Item #11
12.
DISCUSSION REGARDING ALLOWING DOGS IN CITY PARKS
Presented by Parks & Recreation Director Harding
ACTION: That the City Council discuss and offer staff direction regarding dogs in City parks.
Item #12
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
13.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONFIRMATION OF THE COST FOR NUISANCE ABATEMENT FOR THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 2403 ESTHER VIEW DRIVE AND THE PLACEMENT OF A LIEN TO RECOUP THOSE COSTS Res 2018-05 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, confirming the cost, and ordering the recordation of an abatement lien against the property located at 2403 Esther View Drive (APN 7553-019-042) in the amount of $1,450.
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the resolution confirming the cost to abate a public nuisance for the property located at 2403 Esther View Drive in the amount of $1,450; and direct staff to file a lien on the property for the cost of the abatement.
Item #13
14.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of Raymone (Rae) Potts, Rocky Rinehart, William (Bill) Keenan, Louise Culp and Sara Anderson to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, February 6, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
